plugins.name: skill-help
plugins.description: Show the usage, flags and arguments of any installed Claude Code skill, slash command or plugin — the slash-command menu only shows a truncated one-line description, and there is no built-in way to see a single skill's interface. Resolves user, project and plugin-provided entries across both the skills/ and commands/ layouts, lists everything with full untruncated descriptions, and documents how to make your own skills self-describing with the argument-hint frontmatter field.
